promise.body: The thing you said you would sort out did not get sorted out. Word travels.

escalated.title: The memo resurfaces
escalated.body: Someone outside the building read it. Standing recovers, and then some.

wellRested.title: Astonishingly well rested
wellRested.body: The nap was, it turns out, load-bearing.

audit.title: Routine inventory audit
audit.body: Procurement cannot account for a shipment. Nobody is accusing anybody.

mossNight.title: The night audit
mossNight.body: Moss files the joint count at 04:12. It is thorough, it is signed twice, and the board reads it.

biaDoor.title: Facilities request
biaDoor.body: A form arrives asking who authorised entry. Nobody at Nutshell Inc. admits to sending it. Bia has stopped using that stairwell.

check-in.title: A quick word
check-in.blurb: No agenda. That is itself unusual here.

open.prompt: Oh — hello. I was just going to write this down and never mention it, so this is probably better.

listen.label: What is on your mind?
listen.reply: Right. Okay. It is a small thing, but it adds up.

praise.label: You have been doing good work.
praise.reply: I have? I mean — yes. I have. Thank you. I will keep doing the work.

quota.label: Can you push a little harder this week?
quota.reply: I can. I will. I am noting that you asked, not because I am cross, just — noting it.

listened.prompt: The equipment in here was requisitioned in a cycle nobody will name, and one of the drawers screams. Not loudly. Just enough.

fix.label: I will get it replaced. Properly.
fix.reply: You are going to actually do it? Sorry. That was rude. Thank you.

promise.label: I'll look into it.
promise.reply: You will look into it. Great. I will put that in the file with the others.

thanks.label: Thanks for telling me.
thanks.reply: Any time. Genuinely. It is nice to be asked.

suspicious-memo.title: A memo that should not exist
suspicious-memo.blurb: It was in the wrong tray, which is how anyone ever finds anything.

open.prompt: I found this in with the supply forms. It has our letterhead. It has a subject line. It does not have an author, a date, or any of the sentences you would expect a memo to have.

read.label: Read it to me.
read.reply: Alright. Bear with me. Some of it is in a different hand.

shred.label: Shred it. We never saw it.
shred.reply: Understood. For the record I did see it, but I take your meaning.

read.prompt: It describes a study. Eighteen participants. It refers to them by room. And at the bott, in pencil, someone has written "they are getting better at it".

escalate.label: This goes outside the building.
escalate.reply: Outside. Right. That is — yes. That is the correct answer and I did not expect it.

bury.label: File it under Q3 and forget it.
bury.reply: Q3. Of course. I will forget it immediately and permanently and think about it every night.

ask.label: Do you think it is about us?
ask.reply: I think if it were about anyone else, it would not have been in our tray.

gift.title: Something for you
gift.blurb: Morale, in this company, is a line item. It does not have to be.

open.prompt: You are holding something behind your back and doing a very poor job of it.

acorn.label: A good acorn snack. (500)
acorn.reply: Oh, this is a GOOD one. Look at the shoulders on it.

golden.label: A golden nut. (1 golden)
golden.reply: That is — no. That is too much. I am keeping it. But it is too much.

coffee.label: The last of the good coffee.
coffee.reply: The GOOD one? From the back? I am going to get so much done. Possibly too much.

plant.label: A little potted cutting. (300)
plant.reply: A plant! Something to look after. Thank you.

puzzle.label: A tiny puzzle box. (900)
puzzle.reply: A puzzle box. I will absolutely not do this during meetings.

scarf.label: A cosy knitted scarf. (1,500)
scarf.reply: Hand-knitted? It is so soft. I may never take it off.

slump.title: Everyone can feel it
slump.blurb: Morale is low enough that pretending otherwise is its own insult.

open.prompt: Can I be honest? Nobody is okay this week. We have all been very polite about it, which is somehow worse.

own-it.label: This one is on me.
own-it.reply: That is not what I expected. Thank you. That actually helps more than the alternative.

deflect.label: It has been a hard quarter for everyone.
deflect.reply: A hard quarter. Right. I will pass that along to everyone during the hard quarter.

buy-lunch.label: Everyone off the floor. Lunch is on the company. (4,000)
buy-lunch.reply: You are serious. Everyone! Off the floor! Before it is rescinded!

pip-doubt.title: The founder, after hours
pip-doubt.blurb: She has been re-reading the same page of the ledger for some time.

open.prompt: Do you ever think I invented a company so I would have somewhere to put the worrying? Everyone here trusts me and I am mostly guessing.

reassure.label: Everyone here is here because of you.
reassure.reply: Because of me. Right. That is the bit that makes it heavy, but — thank you. I needed the sentence.

honest.label: You are guessing. So is everyone. You guess carefully.
honest.reply: Carefully. I will take carefully. Careful is a thing I can keep being.

reassured.prompt: She closes the ledger, which she has not done all cycle.

share.label: Tell me what you actually wanted this place to be.
share.reply: Somewhere nobody has to be brilliant to be safe. That was the whole idea. It is still the idea.

work.label: Then let us get back to it.
work.reply: Yes. Work. Work I can do. Thank you for not making me talk about it any more.

open.prompt: ...mm. I am awake. I was processing. I process better with my eyes shut and my face on the desk.

let-sleep.label: Carry on. Process away.
let-sleep.reply: You are a good employer. I will remember this in about four hours.

wake.label: I need you actually awake.
wake.reply: Awake. Yes. This is me awake. This is what it looks like. It is not sustainable but it is happening.

join.label: Budge up.
join.reply: The company is asleep on the job with me. This is the best day of my employment.

rizzo-inventory.title: An inventory discrepancy
rizzo-inventory.blurb: The numbers are fine. The numbers are, in fact, too fine.

open.prompt: Before you say anything: the inventory balances. It balances beautifully. It balances better than it did before, which I admit raises questions.

ask-where.label: Where did the extra crate come from?
ask-where.reply: Define "come from". Legally. Because I have thought about this and I do not love my answer.

dont-ask.label: The inventory balances. Good work.
dont-ask.reply: The inventory balances. Excellent. We are going to get along extremely well.

confessed.prompt: It was on the loading dock with no paperwork for eleven days. I checked. Every day. It was becoming ours by attrition.

return-it.label: Find out whose it is and return it.
return-it.reply: Return it. Fine. FINE. I will be very honourable about it and hate every second.

split-it.label: Split it and never speak of it.
split-it.reply: Now THAT is procurement. I have never respected a mammal more.

promote.label: You watched a dock for eleven days. That is a skill.
promote.reply: It IS a skill! Nobody has ever called it a skill! I am going to be so good at this job.

moss-count.title: What the night shift counts
moss-count.blurb: Moss has a tally sheet. The tally is going up.

open.prompt: There are eleven doors on the research floor. I have counted them every night for two hundred nights. Last night there were twelve. I would like you to know that I am not upset about it. I am simply keeping records.

log.label: Then we file it. Officially, with the number you counted.
log.reply: Officially. Good. I have been carrying it alone and it was becoming heavy in a way numbers should not be.

hush.label: Count the doors again in the morning, and stop counting at night.
hush.reply: In the morning there are eleven. That is why I count at night. But you are the founder, so: eleven. I will write eleven.

join.label: I'll come and count them with you tonight.
join.reply: You will be tired tomorrow and the office will notice. Bring something warm. We start at the stairwell and work anticlockwise.

filed.prompt: She squares the tally sheet against the desk edge until it is exactly parallel.

thank.label: Thank you for telling me instead of anyone else.
thank.reply: You are the only one who does not ask me whether I am sure. I am always sure. That is the difficult part.

ask.label: What is behind the twelfth door?
ask.reply: A corridor of the correct length for a building slightly larger than this one. I did not go in. I am an observer.

moss-ledger.title: The corrected record
moss-ledger.blurb: The filing came back. Somebody has been helpful.

open.prompt: Our submission was returned stamped RECONCILED. Where I wrote twelve, it now reads eleven, in my handwriting, which I did not write. I am telling you before I tell the tally sheet.

accept.label: Eleven is the number the company can use. Let it stand.
accept.reply: Then eleven it is. I will stop counting doors and start counting something the company would prefer. Windows, perhaps. There are nine.

recount.label: Charter a night audit. We count it again, properly, on the record.
recount.reply: An audit. With a budget and a form and everything. Nobody has ever spent money on believing me before. Bring the warm thing again.

bia-door.title: The corridor she walks past
bia-door.blurb: Bia has been given a route. The route goes around something.

open.prompt: My patrol sheet has me turn left at the basement stair. There is a door straight ahead. The sheet does not say avoid it, it just never mentions it, which is a thing I have started noticing. I am not asking to open it. I am asking whether I am allowed to ask.

back.label: You're allowed to ask me anything. That's the job.
back.reply: Right. Okay. Good. Then my question is: who writes the patrol sheets? Because it is not you and it is not facilities.

open-it.label: Open it. I want to know what we are walking around.
open-it.reply: On it. I will do it properly, with the log and the torch and everything. ... It was not locked. That is the part I keep coming back to.

seal.label: Seal it, log it, and keep the route as written.
seal.reply: Sealed and logged. Honestly? That is the answer I was hoping for. I like knowing where the edges are.

settled.prompt: She checks the torch, switches it off, and checks it again.

snacks.label: Restock the snack shelf. Properly, out of company funds.
snacks.reply: Out of company funds. I am going to read that sentence again later when I am off shift.

rounds.label: Walk the rounds with me. Show me what you've noticed.
rounds.reply: Sure. Fair warning, it takes a while, because I stop at everything. That is sort of the point of me.

defer.label: Leave this decision for another time.
defer.reply: That is all right. We do not have to decide now.

pip.scene: A ring on the first company ledger.
pip.prompt: The handle broke on our first day. I kept saying I would replace it. Funny what survives.

care.label: Repair the handle. Keep the chip.
care.reply: Oh. It still looks like mine. Thank you.

other.label: Put it in the company archive.
other.reply: An exhibit? I was still drinking out of that.

marlow.scene: HR has reserved a quiet corner.
marlow.prompt: Everyone calls this my chair. It is actually where people sit when they cannot say what is wrong yet.

care.label: Restuff it. Leave the corner quiet.
care.reply: No appointment required. That is the important part.

other.label: Keep it in HR, away from the floor.
other.reply: A longer walk for someone who already finds it hard to ask.

rizzo.scene: A stapler wrapped in an old receipt.
rizzo.prompt: No serial number. No warranty. Never jams. I can tell you two of those facts are related.

care.label: Buy the right staples. Ask nothing.
care.reply: You understand procurement. Finally.

other.label: Request the original receipt.
other.reply: Absolutely. Give me a minute and your oldest pen.

bea.scene: Bea has measured the same plank three times.
bea.prompt: Straight grain. No knots. A shelf would waste it. A bridge would be showing off.

care.label: Make a step for the shorter staff.
care.reply: Useful. Load-bearing. I like how you think.

other.label: Save it for the next expansion.
other.reply: Then nobody cuts it for a meeting-room sign. Agreed?

corvus.scene: Marketing has booked a silent rehearsal.
corvus.prompt: I can reach the entire building with this. I have never tried asking whether the building wants that.

care.label: Fit a volume limiter.
care.reply: Fine. The campaign can have an inside voice.

other.label: Book one spectacular announcement.
other.reply: One? Then I shall make it count.

mina.scene: There is dust on the inside of the lenses.
mina.prompt: These scratches are from below the basement. This one is from above it. Same stone. Different direction.

care.label: Replace the lenses and log the find.
care.reply: Good. I would hate to miss it happening again.

other.label: Close that excavation for now.
other.reply: I can stop digging. The noise might not.

nixie.scene: The gadget has a button labelled NOT YET.
nixie.prompt: It sorts paperclips by emotional significance. The jam is a wedding invitation.

care.label: Build a manual release.
care.reply: A way out that does not need permission. Yes.

other.label: Put the prototype through testing.
other.reply: Quincy will find the bug. Please ask him not to eat it.

otto.scene: One page has been folded instead of filed.
otto.prompt: The numbers balance. The staff bought their own birthday cake. These facts should not coexist.

care.label: Reimburse the cake.
care.reply: There. Now the books look right.

other.label: Keep the expense outside the budget.
other.reply: Balanced is not the same as fair. I will make a note.

hazel.scene: The gavel rests on a coaster, very formally.
hazel.prompt: A tiny gavel still makes a ruling. Today: whether unpaid tea breaks count as tea.

care.label: Recognise tea breaks as paid time.
care.reply: Motion carried. With biscuits.

other.label: Ask for a written opinion.
other.reply: I have seventeen pages ready. Both sides are tea-stained.

junie.scene: Three meetings occupy the same square.
junie.prompt: I can deliver anything five minutes early. Except myself. There is only one of me.

care.label: Pay for a relief shift.
care.reply: An empty square. I had forgotten what those looked like.

other.label: Cancel the least useful meeting.
other.reply: That leaves... most of Tuesday.

moss.scene: The telescope points toward an interior wall.
moss.prompt: No stars tonight. But someone on the other side blinked. They seemed as surprised as I was.

care.label: Clean the lens. Keep the observation private.
care.reply: Thank you for not calling it a reflection.

other.label: Submit the observation to research.
other.reply: Use pencil. The last report corrected itself.

fenn.scene: An unsigned offer peeks out of the case.
fenn.prompt: The client wants delivery tomorrow. We can promise it today or tell the truth today.

care.label: Fund the honest delivery estimate.
care.reply: Harder to sell. Easier to sleep. I can work with that.

other.label: Let the client walk away.
other.reply: You know, they might respect that. I almost do.

pingo.scene: Every route ends at the same coffee stain.
pingo.prompt: There is a shorter route through the cold store. There is a warmer one past everyone who says hello.

care.label: Allow time for the warmer route.
care.reply: The parcels will arrive. So will I.

other.label: Map the cold-store shortcut.
other.reply: Efficient. I will pack a second scarf.

canela.scene: A leaf marks a page about the office fern.
canela.prompt: It leans toward conversations, not windows. I moved it twice to check.

care.label: Give the fern a place near the team.
care.reply: Finally, a subject with a healthy social life.

other.label: Keep a week of quiet observations.
other.reply: No cages. No labels on the leaves. Just a notebook.

nino.scene: The meeting chair has a reserved sign.
nino.prompt: I approve the new agenda. It contains a blank page. My cushion and I will chair that section.

care.label: Move the cushion into the sunshine.
care.reply: A management decision I can support completely.

other.label: Let somebody else chair the meeting.
other.reply: Delegation. My most exhausting talent.

bia.scene: The honey tin is labelled EMERGENCY ONLY.
bia.prompt: A bad day counts. A good day worth sharing also counts. Security has a broad definition of emergency.

care.label: Refill it for the next night shift.
care.reply: I will leave the spoon where everyone can reach it.

other.label: Ask her to share it now.
other.reply: I was hoping you would.

quincy.scene: The jar contains a bug and a complaint form.
quincy.prompt: He is not a defect. He is a visitor. The software bugs are on the other desk.

care.label: Build a little habitat outside.
care.reply: Release notes: one very happy beetle.

other.label: Record the bug before releasing it.
other.reply: Species: guest. Severity: adorable.

dorm.scene: A patch is older than the company logo.
dorm.prompt: I fixed this... slowly. Things last when you let them rest between being useful.

care.label: Replace the frayed suspension rope.
care.reply: Excellent. I will test it... thoroughly.

other.label: Schedule a company rest break.
other.reply: For everyone? Even the clocks?

inky.scene: Seven tentacles are waiting for the eighth.
inky.prompt: One colour for every queue. The purple one is for things nobody wants to claim. It is nearly dry.

care.label: Refill the ink and share the backlog.
care.reply: Eight hands does not mean eight employees. Thank you.

other.label: Sort the unclaimed queue together.
other.reply: Oh. This one is addressed to the building.

echo.scene: A low note hangs in an empty corridor.
echo.prompt: The building hums in B-flat. Last night it answered in C. I was very polite about it.

care.label: Fit soft pads to the noisy machinery.
care.reply: Now I can hear myself think. And possibly someone else.

other.label: Record the answer after closing time.
other.reply: Stay beside me. It is less strange with company.

rosa.scene: A faded ribbon is pinned behind the campaign board.
rosa.prompt: First launch. No budget. Everyone wore a piece. We looked ridiculous and nobody felt left out.

care.label: Buy enough ribbon for the whole team.
care.reply: Matching? Never. Belonging? Absolutely.

other.label: Frame the original ribbon.
other.reply: Leave a little tail loose. History needs movement.

perry.scene: A receipt has been made out to nobody.
perry.prompt: The supplier delivered on time. The supplier does not exist. I would like to pay them anyway.

care.label: Set the payment aside, properly recorded.
care.reply: Good accounting makes very few assumptions.

other.label: Ask procurement to trace the delivery.
other.reply: Start with the footsteps. They only go out.

axel.scene: The smallest cutting has grown a second label.
axel.prompt: I grow replacements for things people break. This one is for something nobody has broken yet.

care.label: Give the cuttings a proper growing tray.
care.reply: We can wait until somebody needs them.

other.label: Ask what the second label says.
other.reply: It says thank you. In my handwriting. I did not write it.

mail.title: A letter from the building
mail.body: Inky has received a reply. The envelope is warm. The return address is the floor underneath his desk.
mail.returnReply: The envelope is gone before the post trolley arrives.
mail.request: Please stop calling the pipes obsolete. They are trying their best.
mail.quietReply: The next morning, the radiators make a sound suspiciously like a sigh.
mail.listen: Ask Echo to translate the recording.
mail.listenReply: It was not a complaint. It was asking whether we were comfortable.
mail.fileReply: Inky leaves the drawer slightly open. Just in case.

cutting.title: A second thank-you
cutting.body: Axel's cutting has produced another label: YOU CAN WRITE BACK. The handwriting is smaller this time.
cutting.answerReply: Axel places the reply where the roots can read it.
cutting.measureReply: The sample contains ink, water, and a very small amount of disappointment.
cutting.laterBody: Axel brings you a leaf with nothing written on it. For once, the company has no questions.

coffee.title: Coffee for the night shift
coffee.body: Your rescued coffee is ready. Pip has set out cups for the staff who never make the daytime photos.
coffee.mug: Use Pip's repaired mug for the first cup.
coffee.mugReply: Same cup. Better company. Pip does not make a speech.
coffee.sell: Sell the extra cups to visitors.

bugs.title: Quality is a kindness
bugs.body: Quincy found the last fault before a parcel left. Nothing went wrong today. He is trying to explain why that deserves celebrating.
bugs.credit: Put his name on the release notes.
bugs.creditReply: He reads the line twice, then pretends to check the spelling.
bugs.habitat: Celebrate by the beetle's new home.
bugs.habitatReply: Two successful releases. Neither needed a cage.
bugs.deadline: Use the saved time to raise the quota.

cable.title: The unlabelled cable
cable.body: The desk is finally untangled. One cable remains. Both ends point into the wall, and Nixie insists it was not there before.
cable.label: Label it: do not unplug.
cable.labelReply: For the first time, the wall has a clear instruction.
cable.wall: Behind the skirting board is a button labelled NOT YET. It has been pressed from the other side.
cable.releaseReply: A click. The cable goes slack. Somewhere, a paperclip is free.
cable.leave: Leave a note for the next shift.
cable.leaveReply: Nixie writes: WE SAW IT TOO. Nobody should investigate alone.

callback.needsRecording: Ask Echo to record a reply first.
callback.needsHabitat: Help Quincy with the bug jar first.
callback.needsManual: Help Nixie document the gadget first.

ensemble.title: Room recipes
ensemble.intro: Three pieces, one purpose. Arrange them together in the named room. The benefit lasts while the complete set is placed there.
ensemble.active: In use · contributing to the company
ensemble.inactive: Stored pieces do not count. Arrange the missing pieces in this room.

quiet-corner.name: A little breathing room
quiet-corner.effect: A plant, a lamp, somewhere to put your feet. Station combos wait 10% longer.

proper-break.name: An actual break
proper-break.effect: The fish supervise the snacks. Resting morale rises by 3.

living-lab.name: Science with leaves
living-lab.effect: The plants are the control group. Company production gains 4%.

paper-trail.name: Everything in its place
paper-trail.effect: Fewer duplicate requisitions: purchases cost 2% less. One drawer is filing itself.

night-watch.name: Someone is watching
night-watch.effect: The keys match every door except one. Rare-event luck gains 4%. Check the monitors.

sprout-club.name: The smallest department
sprout-club.effect: Warmth, water, and unreasonable expectations. Morale recovers 8% faster. A leaf has signed the attendance sheet.

ensemble.selection: Arrange these pieces in {{room}}. Stored pieces or pieces in another room do not activate the recipe.

archive.title: Filed tomorrow
archive.body: The new catalogue is perfectly alphabetized. Under your company name sits a personnel file dated tomorrow. Its paper is still warm.
archive.return: Put it back. Tomorrow is not on today’s agenda.
archive.returned: The drawer shuts politely. Someone inside clears their throat.
archive.signature: The report describes a remarkably ordinary day. One line is wrong: “Nobody noticed the extra signature.” Beneath it, a space waits for yours.
archive.corrected: The ink fades, then returns as “Thank you.” A copy enters your restricted files.
archive.signed: Two golden nuts slide from the binding. The signature is yours. The handwriting is not.

security.title: Camera thirteen
security.body: The room has twelve cameras. Monitor thirteen shows the office three seconds ahead. In it, someone is about to wave.
security.wave: Wave first. It seems rude not to.
security.waved: The other office waves back, late. Everyone agrees not to measure the delay.
security.unplug: Unplug it and finish today’s work.
security.unplugged: The screen goes dark. For four minutes, every task arrives exactly on time.
security.trace: Use your cable training to trace the signal.
security.needsMastery: Reach 30 points in Cable Untangle first.
security.traced: The cable ends in an empty desk. A nameplate reads “VACANT, UNTIL RECENTLY.” You file the photograph.

incubator.title: The plant clocked in
incubator.body: The incubator’s attendance sheet has a new signature: a damp leaf print. The seedling is already leaning toward the coffee queue.
incubator.badged: Employee 24 declines a desk and requests a sunny windowsill. Its probation period is seasonal.
incubator.observed: You leave a blank form beside the pot. Something begins filling it out.
incubator.laterBody: The plant has deposited one golden nut. Its note says “rent”.

return.title: The previous tenant
return.body: New company. New paperwork. On the first windowsill sits the same plant, wearing a badge from the previous timeline. It has kept your seat warm.
return.welcome: Welcome it back. Keep the old badge.
return.welcomed: A leaf turns toward you. For once, the company remembers something worth keeping.
return.rent: Ask whether the rent crossed timelines too.
return.rented: Two golden nuts. No forwarding address.

unknown.title: An unindexed finding
unknown.body: The evidence survived. The department that named it did not leave a forwarding address.

memo_basement.title: A memo from below
memo_basement.body: The basement has a basement. The drawing stops there; the stair count does not.

basement_basement.title: Another flight down
basement_basement.body: A floor plan with a staircase drawn outside the paper.

break_room_nation.title: The break-room constitution
break_room_nation.body: Article one: nobody is too important to wash their own mug.

chair.title: The extra chair
chair.body: Nobody ordered it. The upholstery remembers everybody.

fire_science.title: A revised safety procedure
fire_science.body: Step one is now underlined. So is the signature of the extinguisher.

ghost.title: A transparent appointment
ghost.body: No reflection. Excellent attendance. Payroll would like clarification.

negative_nut.title: The missing quantity
negative_nut.body: One nut less than an empty drawer. Counting it makes the room quieter.

nutcoin.title: A discontinued currency
nutcoin.body: Backed by collective optimism and one very ordinary acorn.

secret_ledger.title: The second ledger
secret_ledger.body: Every entry balances. Nobody recognizes the expenses.

secret_requisition.title: Requisition without a sender
secret_requisition.body: The delivery was signed for before the request was written.

sideways.title: The lateral department
sideways.body: A corridor that fits between two neighboring rooms. The architect has stopped answering.

spreadsheet.title: An unsaved workbook
spreadsheet.body: Cell B12 keeps calculating what would have happened if you had gone home.

too_round.title: A geometrically suspicious nut
too_round.body: Perfectly round. Rolled uphill during inspection. Marked “probably fine”.

wind_chime.title: The indoor forecast
wind_chime.body: There is no draft in this room. The chime disagrees at lunchtime.

anomaly_tomorrow.title: Tomorrow’s corrected report
anomaly_tomorrow.body: Someone noticed. The document has amended its prediction.

anomaly_signature.title: Your other signature
anomaly_signature.body: Same name. Different handwriting. The payment cleared yesterday.

anomaly_wave.title: A delayed greeting
anomaly_wave.body: Security footage of the office waving to itself. The timestamps disagree politely.

anomaly_futureDesk.title: Vacant, until recently
anomaly_futureDesk.body: A desk with a warm seat and a cable connected to tomorrow.

anomaly_employee24.title: Personnel file 024
anomaly_employee24.body: Position: windowsill. Preferred working hours: daylight. Leaves available upon request.

anomaly_previousTenant.title: Something worth keeping
anomaly_previousTenant.body: The company changed timelines. A small plant declined to forget you.

anomaly_silence.title: Blank broadcast reel
anomaly_silence.body: Studio log, recorded by Echo. Three minutes of near silence; a kettle clicks at 01:42. The recording made the building feel occupied rather than busy.

anomaly_deskNames.title: Underside rubbing
anomaly_deskNames.body: Repair order R-23. Pencil rubbing taken before the desk returned to service. The last name is legible; the date is not. Bea refuses to classify it as damage.

anomaly_thursday.title: A damp calendar leaf
anomaly_thursday.body: Winter garden, witnessed by Axel. Two ring stains, one on each side of the bench. No chemical anomaly survived. The invitation did.

anomaly_hum.title: The building hums
anomaly_hum.body: Night-shift tape, 3:00, filed by Moss and Echo. The whole building humming the company jingle, slower and fonder. It comes up from the basement. It sounds happy.

anomaly_floorZero.title: The floor with no number
anomaly_floorZero.body: Moss for a carpet, a window full of stars, the whole team asleep and smiling. The elevator has no record of stopping there. It did.

anomaly_thirteenth.title: The thirteenth button
anomaly_thirteenth.body: Unnumbered, acorn-shaped, warm to the touch. According to Moss it has always been there. Maintenance declined to comment, in pencil.

annex.work: Take this idea back to work

broadcast.title: The silence request
broadcast.body: The radio receives a request signed by every room in the building. They would like three minutes without being useful. Echo has already put a blank reel on the machine.
broadcast.reply: The office stops clattering. When the tape ends, someone keeps humming the silence.
broadcast.other: The sponsor asks for the listening figures. Every room reports zero.
broadcast.evidence: Studio log, recorded by Echo. Three minutes of near silence; a kettle clicks at 01:42. The recording made the building feel occupied rather than busy.
broadcast.workReply: Echo turns the microphone toward the person who usually takes the minutes.
broadcast.roomQuip: Does this microphone pick up sighs too?
broadcast.afterQuip: Since that broadcast, the silence here feels like company.
broadcast.remember: Reserve three quiet minutes in every broadcast.
broadcast.work: Give the microphone to whoever takes the minutes.
broadcast.keptQuip: Three minutes. No targets. Echo put it on the schedule.

repair.title: Do not repair this scratch
repair.body: Bea finds twenty-three names scratched under a returned desk. Most are familiar. One is yours, in handwriting you have not learned yet. The repair order says: remove all evidence of use.
repair.reply: Bea repairs the legs and leaves the names. On the invoice: structurally sound, personally important.
repair.other: The desk passes inspection. Bea keeps a rubbing of the old names in her apron.
repair.evidence: Repair order R-23. Pencil rubbing taken before the desk returned to service. The last name is legible; the date is not. Bea refuses to classify it as damage.
repair.workReply: Bea puts the old screws in a labelled tin. Still useful, she says.
repair.roomQuip: Nothing broken comes in without telling us what happened.
repair.afterQuip: That desk has more history than the instruction manual.
repair.remember: Leave the names. Add a line for the next person.
repair.work: Keep the spare screws for the next repair.
repair.keptReply: Bea draws a small blank line below the signatures. “A repair should leave room for whoever comes next.”
repair.keptQuip: There is an empty line under that desk. We are saving it.

conservatory.title: Thursday, indoors
conservatory.body: The rain collector is full of warm tea. Axel checks the roof, the pipes, and finally the calendar. Someone has written: THURSDAY — BE KIND. It is Tuesday.
conservatory.b: Bottle it as a research sample
conservatory.reply: The second cup is empty before anyone arrives. Axel leaves the bench unfolded for tomorrow.
conservatory.other: The bottle label becomes damp. The sample is ordinary rainwater by lunchtime.
conservatory.evidence: Winter garden, witnessed by Axel. Two ring stains, one on each side of the bench. No chemical anomaly survived. The invitation did.
conservatory.workReply: Axel opens the window. The rain stops politely at the sill.
conservatory.roomQuip: Sunny outside. Apparently not in here.
conservatory.afterQuip: I left the second cup. Just in case.
conservatory.remember: Keep a second cup on the bench, even on Tuesdays.
conservatory.work: Open the window and let the garden breathe.
conservatory.keptReply: Axel writes TWO CUPS on the watering rota. Nobody has to explain who the second one is for.
conservatory.keptQuip: The second cup is still warm. Nobody has touched it.

gifts.quietVisit: Stay a while. Look through your scrapbook while they finish this thought.
gifts.memoryFiled: You found their favourite. It is in your scrapbook now.

reactions.pip: You remembered the coffee. I can stop pretending this mug is just a paperweight.
reactions.marlow: A snack with no meeting attached. You understand me.
reactions.rizzo: Real gold? I will record its location. Privately. In my pocket.
reactions.bea: Good grain. No cracks. I am saving half for the walk home.
reactions.corvus: A limited edition with an audience of one. Excellent positioning.
reactions.mina: A puzzle box! Something to dig into that isn't the floor. I'm going to be up all night.
reactions.nixie: Warm enough to solder by. I am kidding. Mostly.
reactions.otto: A perfectly ordinary acorn. No receipt needed between friends.
reactions.hazel: Interlocking pieces, no loopholes. It's the most beautiful contract I've ever held.
reactions.junie: Still hot! You caught the twelve-second gap in my schedule.
reactions.moss: Coffee for the night watch. Now the thirteenth door can wait.
reactions.fenn: A golden nut, no negotiation. That is a deal worth remembering.
reactions.pingo: A scarf. For a penguin. Not for warmth. For STYLE. I've never felt so well routed.
reactions.canela: A cutting of my own! Entry one: it is perfect. Entry two: so are you.
reactions.nino: Soft. Warm. Smells faintly of sunbeam. You may continue to work here.
reactions.bia: A warm cup makes a long watch shorter. I will save you a seat.
reactions.quincy: A little jungle! Bugs will live in it. I'll leave them alone. Mostly.
reactions.dorm: A snack that waits patiently. We have that in common.
reactions.inky: A puzzle with eight sides! One for each arm. Finally, a fair fight.
reactions.echo: It's so soft. I'm wearing it upside down. That's the right way up for me.
reactions.rosa: Gold catches the light beautifully. I know exactly which ribbon belongs with it.
reactions.perry: A sealed box with a secret inside. You speak my language. I'll open it in a safehouse.
reactions.axel: A new little life. I'll name every leaf. Thank you, thank you, thank you.

polite.pip: I am putting this beside the first acorn. That is the important shelf.
polite.marlow: Thank you. Let us sit down before deciding what it is for.
polite.rizzo: I know a safe place for this. Several, actually.
polite.bea: A gift does not need fixing. I am learning that.
polite.corvus: No campaign? No slogan? This is unexpectedly nice.
polite.mina: I will label it PERSONAL. The lab has trouble with that category.
polite.nixie: I promise not to take it apart before lunch.
polite.otto: I have made a new ledger column: things that do not need balancing.
polite.hazel: No fine print. I checked twice. Thank you.
polite.junie: I have scheduled a moment to appreciate this. Right now.
polite.moss: I will keep it where the moon reaches the desk.
polite.fenn: You did not ask for anything back. I noticed.
polite.pingo: This one stays here. Not everything needs a forwarding address.
polite.canela: I have a dry pocket for it. Fieldwork teaches you to make room.
polite.nino: Can I keep it beside the cushion? That is where good things go.
polite.bia: No need to sign in for this. You are expected.
polite.quincy: I will put it outside the quarantine line. That is a compliment.
polite.dorm: I may look asleep. I am appreciating it very carefully.
polite.inky: An actual present instead of another task. All eight hands approve.
polite.echo: I will leave a little silence after saying thank you.
polite.rosa: I will not change a thing. Sometimes the gesture is the design.
polite.perry: I can file it under unexpected kindness. There is room.
polite.axel: I will keep it by the cuttings. Things grow better with company.

liked.pip: An acorn! A spare one, for the drawer. For emergencies. Every acorn is an emergency.
liked.marlow: A scarf. I'll wear it during the slow parts of the day. Which is all of them. Lovely.
liked.rizzo: A puzzle box. I'll have it open in four seconds. Three if nobody's watching.
liked.bea: A little plant. It'll grow into wood one day. I respect a long-term plan.
liked.corvus: Coffee! Fuel for genius. And for questionable ideas. Mostly the second.
liked.mina: Coffee for the night dig. You know exactly how deep my days go.
liked.nixie: A puzzle! I'll solve it, then build a machine that solves it faster. Then hug it.
liked.otto: Gold… so shiny. I'm not going to chase it. I'm going to look at it. Very calmly.
liked.hazel: A golden nut. I'll log it under 'gifts, received, delighted'. Twice.
liked.junie: A scarf! I'll wear it between meetings. All four seconds of between.
liked.moss: A scarf for the night watch. The quiet hours are cold. This makes them kind.
liked.fenn: Coffee. You've read the room. I respect a good read.
liked.pingo: Coffee, on schedule. Exactly when I needed it. You've timed this beautifully.
liked.canela: An acorn. I'll sketch it before I eat it. Science first.
liked.nino: A snack. You may stroke the top of my head. Once.
liked.bia: An acorn snack. Not honey, but I'll allow it. Big paws, big thanks.
liked.quincy: Coffee! I'll test it thoroughly. All of it. Right now.
liked.dorm: A scarf… so soft… I'll wear it… for my next… three… naps.
liked.inky: Coffee for the free arm. There's always one free arm for coffee.
liked.echo: An acorn for the night shift. I'll eat it upside down. It tastes better.
liked.rosa: A scarf! I know exactly how to drape it. Over one shoulder. Over one leg.
liked.perry: A golden nut. Untraceable. Perfect. I'll file it under 'acquired legitimately'.
liked.axel: An acorn! I could plant it… or eat it… I'll do both, emotionally.

odd.pip: A puzzle? I'm already running a company. THAT's the puzzle. …I'll keep it on the important shelf.
odd.marlow: Coffee. For me. I will… sip it… extremely slowly… Oh. Oh my. Everything is very fast now.
odd.rizzo: A scarf? Where would I hide things? …Oh. In the scarf. You genius.
odd.bea: Gold? Can I build with it? No? Then it's just shiny wood that forgot how to be wood.
odd.corvus: A plant. It doesn't trend. It just… grows. Slowly. Without a strategy. Fascinating.
odd.mina: A scarf? Underground it's always the same temperature. I'll wear it as a digging bandana.
odd.nixie: A plant? I can't take it apart. Why can't I take it apart? I'll give it a little motor.
odd.otto: A puzzle box? I keep trying to balance it. It won't balance. It's a box.
odd.hazel: Coffee? I read contracts twice. With this I'll read them four times. In a minute.
odd.junie: A plant? I'd have to water it. On a schedule. …Fine. I'll schedule it. With love.
odd.moss: A golden nut. Very bright. Too bright for the night watch. I'll keep it in my pocket, where it is quiet.
odd.fenn: An acorn? I sell acorns. I don't receive acorns. …Fine. I'm touched. Don't tell anyone.
odd.pingo: Gold? You can't eat it, you can't swim with it. I'll put it at the end of the route. A finish line.
odd.canela: A golden nut. I'll take notes on it. Note one: it's very shiny. Note two: why?
odd.nino: A puzzle. I will knock it off the desk. That is my solution.
odd.bia: A plant? I'll keep it in the vault. It's safe there. It's very confused there.
odd.quincy: A scarf. For a frog. I'm a little damp. It's a little damp now too. We're bonding.
odd.dorm: Coffee… for me?… I'll drink it… tomorrow… slowly… just in case.
odd.inky: A scarf. For which arm? I've tried all eight. It's a very long scarf now.
odd.echo: Coffee at night? I'm already awake at night. Now I'm awake at night faster.
odd.rosa: An acorn. Not pink. Not shiny. …I'm going to make it a tiny hat. Watch me.
odd.perry: A plant. It can't keep a secret. Everyone can see it. I'll keep it in a briefcase.
odd.axel: Coffee? I don't need it. I'm always this happy. Now I'm this happy, but fast.

hint.plant: {{name}} has been watering the office plants.
hint.puzzle: {{name}} has been doodling mazes on memos.
hint.scarf: {{name}} has been shivering by the window.

tip.team: Hire, place and get to know your animals.
tip.upgrades: Machines, rooms and improvements for the company.
tip.decorate: Buy furniture and arrange every floor.
tip.activities: Short breaks with the team: office minigames and Focus.
tip.archive: The company, collections, achievements and records.

crate.why: Half of what the team makes is packed here. Collect it to get every nut.
crate.waiting: Your crate holds {{value}} nuts. Tap it to collect.

rush.toRush: Keep the rhythm: {{left}} more taps to rush
rush.tip: Keep a combo going for {{taps}} taps and everyone in this room works at double pace for {{seconds}}s.
rush.empty: Nobody works here yet: a rush only speeds up the people in the room.

line.operational: Found these behind the filing cabinet. For you!
line.social: Someone left a whole basket. Sharing is caring.
line.industrial: Shook the machine. Nuts fell out.
line.secure: Found this in the lost and found. Finders keepers.
line.irregular: Don't ask where this came from. Just take it.

pip.title: The First Acorn

1.prompt: Can I show you something? I kept the very first acorn. It's lived in my mug drawer since day one. Yesterday it… sprouted.

a.label: That's wonderful. Let's keep it safe.
a.reply: I knew you'd say that. I've already labelled it 'Do not reorganise'.

b.label: Shouldn't it be in soil?
b.reply: Soil. Right. Obviously. I was going to think of that. Eventually.

2.prompt: The sprout has two leaves now. Two! I check on it between meetings. Is that a normal amount of checking?

a.reply: …Hmmmm-mm. It goes up at the end, like a question. Do you hear it now?

b.label: Could it be the plumbing?
b.reply: Plumbing doesn't harmonise with itself. Usually. I'll keep listening.

2.prompt: I recorded it. Played backwards, it's the day the company was founded. Played forwards, it's a lullaby.

a.label: Play it for the night shift.
a.reply: The whole night shift sat still and listened. Moss cried a little. Owls do that.

b.label: Ask Moss what it means.
b.reply: Moss said 'the tree remembers us while we sleep'. Then she went to look at a fern.

prompt.a: You heard it. You said so. I wasn't sure anyone would ever hear what I hear. I've stopped feeling odd.
prompt.b: Not the plumbing, then. The tree hums when the office is happy. Lately it's been very loud.

a.label: Teach me to listen like you.
a.reply: Lesson one: be quiet. Lesson two: be quieter. You're a natural.

b.label: Write the tree a reply.
b.reply: I hummed it a little tune back. It answered. A duet, with a building.

callback.a: The walls hummed your name last night. Kindly.
callback.b: Plumbing report: still not the plumbing.

echo.find: The tree hummed and this fell from a branch. It's warm. Like a song.

rosa.title: The Runway

1.prompt: I'm planning an office fashion show. The runway is the corridor. My fear: nobody walks it, and I'm a flamingo alone.

a.label: I'll walk first.
a.reply: You'd go first? On one leg? Two is fine. Two is wonderful. I may faint.

b.label: Make it a contest. Prizes help.
b.reply: Prizes. Rosettes. Glitter. A little competition brings out the fabulous.

2.prompt: Sign-ups so far: Otto (shiny tie), Bea (wooden shoes), Nino (refuses; will attend lying down). It's happening.

a.label: Give everyone a moment to shine.
a.reply: Everyone gets a spotlight. Even the shy ones. Especially the shy ones.

b.label: Corvus can film it. Viral, darling.
b.reply: Corvus is filming in slow motion. Every step is a moment. I'm so nervous.

prompt.a: You walked first, and everyone followed. Even Moss, at midnight, alone, but she walked. It was a debut.
prompt.b: The contest was a sensation. Bea won 'Most Structural Look'. Nobody argued. It was a very good shoe.

a.label: Make it a yearly tradition.
a.reply: The Plume Show, every year. You'll always walk first. That's your title now.

b.label: Take a bow yourself.
b.reply: On one leg. Spotlight. Applause. I didn't know I needed that. Thank you, darling.

callback.a: You walked first. I'll never forget it. Neither will the corridor.
callback.b: Glitter count: everywhere. Worth it.

rosa.find: From the runway: the winning ribbon. You deserve it more.

perry.title: The Unsourceable

1.prompt: In all my years of sourcing, one item has eluded me. A left sock. Specifically, mine. Missing since 2011.

a.label: Then we'll find it together.
a.reply: A joint operation. Codename: Footwear. I'll get the trench coat.

b.label: Just buy new socks, Perry.
b.reply: New socks? That's… surrender. It's also sensible. I hate it. I'll think about it.

2.prompt: Lead: Rizzo was seen near the laundry in 2011. Rizzo says he 'doesn't recall'. Highly suspicious.

a.label: Follow the lead quietly.
a.reply: Quietly. My specialty. Silent as a duck. A duck with a beaver's tail. Very silent.

b.label: Ask Rizzo directly.
b.reply: Asked. Rizzo blinked, then took the sock out of a drawer. Twelve years. 'For safekeeping.'

prompt.a: You followed me through every lead. The sock was in my own coat pocket. Thirteen years. I'm a great spy.
prompt.b: You told me to just buy socks. I bought socks. Then Rizzo returned the old one, ironed. We're… friends now? Enemies who iron.

a.label: Frame the sock.
a.reply: Framed. Case closed. The most beautiful sock in the building. The ONLY sock in the building.

b.label: Wear them both, finally.
b.reply: Both socks. Matching. For the first time since 2011. I feel… complete. And warm.

callback.a: Operation Footwear: ongoing. Very hush.
callback.b: Bought new socks. They feel like betrayal. Comfortable betrayal.

perry.find: Sourced this for you. Don't ask from where. It's legal. Mostly.

axel.title: The Cutting

1.prompt: I took a tiny cutting from the office tree. With permission! I asked the tree. It didn't say no.

a.label: Let's grow it together.
a.reply: Together! I'll water, you encourage. Encouraging is very important for plants.

b.label: Is the tree okay with that?
b.reply: I left it a thank-you note on the bark. It grew a new leaf over it. I think that's a yes.

2.prompt: The cutting grew a leaf shaped like an acorn. Then one like a nut. Then one like… a tiny office?

a.label: Plant it somewhere special.
a.reply: Somewhere with light and company. I know exactly the window.

b.label: Show it to Canela for her notebook.
b.reply: Canela drew it and said 'that's a building'. A building! Growing! I'm so happy I'm pinker.

prompt.a: You grew it with me. It's taller than me now. There's a tiny branch with a tiny desk on it. And a tiny me.
prompt.b: You worried about the tree. The tree's fine. It's PROUD. It grew a sibling. The company has a little sister.

a.label: Let the company grow a new branch.
a.reply: A new branch for new friends. Anything can grow back. Anything can grow, full stop.

b.label: Let it grow wild.
b.reply: Wild and happy. Like us. Like everything good. I'll be smiling about this for a week.

callback.a: The cutting says hello. It waved. It was the wind. Probably.
callback.b: Thanked the tree again today. It rustled. Politely.

axel.find: The cutting dropped this. It's a seed. For you to grow something.

done.sprout: A golden sprout. It's already dropping nuts.
done.bloom: It bloomed. Something else came up with it.
