vault-pillow.hint: There's a pillow in the vault. On the gold.
vault-pillow.found: A small pillow on the golden nuts, embroidered VAULT SLEEPER. Bia says it isn't hers. Bia embroiders.

still-spinning.title: Still spinning
still-spinning.hint: Something in the lab is still turning.
still-spinning.found: The centrifuge is unplugged and still turning, very slowly, out of what can only be spite.

soup-name-tag.title: Gerald
soup-name-tag.hint: The soup pot has a name tag now.
soup-name-tag.found: A little name tag on the soup pot: GERALD. Please do not stir Gerald without asking.

tree-parcel.title: The parcel on the desk
tree-parcel.hint: The parcel on the founder's desk has moved.
tree-parcel.found: Every morning the unopened parcel is turned a little more towards the window. Today there's a golden nut beside it.

night-hum-tape.title: The night tape
night-hum-tape.hint: A tape in the booth is playing on its own.
night-hum-tape.found: A cassette labelled NIGHT, 3:00 sits on the reel shelf. It plays itself, very quietly, whenever the booth is empty.

moss-by-the-lift.title: A little moss
moss-by-the-lift.hint: There's moss by the elevator. Real moss.
moss-by-the-lift.found: A small patch of soft moss by the elevator door. It's warm, and it smells like a very good nap.

bugBounty.title: The Bug Bounty
bugBounty.hook: Twelve bugs. One gadget. I made a leaderboard.
bugBounty.body: Quincy found twelve bugs in Nixie's new gadget and has pinned a leaderboard to the lab door. Nixie has pinned a smaller sign underneath it that just says PROTOTYPE. They are both looking at you.
bugBounty.quincyReply: "Thirteen, actually. I found one while celebrating."
bugBounty.nixieReply: "See? Proto. Type. It's literally in the word."
bugBounty.contest: Make it a bet: whoever finds the next bug buys lunch.
bugBounty.contestReply: Both of them are suddenly working very, very hard.

rebrand.title: The Rebrand
rebrand.hook: Two words: neon. And also neon.
rebrand.body: Corvus wants the new logo in neon. Rosa wants it in pink. They have each made a mock-up the size of a door, and they are holding them up in the middle of the marketing burrow, refusing to blink first.
rebrand.neonReply: "Iconic. Blinding. Mostly iconic." Rosa has put on sunglasses, in protest.
rebrand.pinkReply: "Darling, pink isn't a colour. It's a promise." Corvus is pretending to read his phone.
rebrand.bothReply: Silence. Then, together: "…We hate how much we love that."

biddingWar.title: The Bidding War
biddingWar.hook: Small problem. Two receipts. One crate.
biddingWar.body: Rizzo and Perry have both 'acquired' the same crate of premium acorns from the same mysterious supplier. Each has a receipt. The receipts are identical, right down to a small coffee stain. Neither will say where the supplier went.
biddingWar.rizzoReply: "I always have it first. It's my whole thing." Perry is quietly writing something down.
biddingWar.perryReply: "Legitimate. Yes. That's one of the words I'd use." Rizzo has asked to see the receipt under a lamp.
biddingWar.auditReply: Otto holds them up to the light for a long time. "Fascinating. They're both real. That's the problem."
biddingWar.auditNeeds: Otto would know. If only he worked here.

nightShift.title: The Night Shift Report
nightShift.hook: We recorded something. At three. You should hear it.
nightShift.body: Moss and Echo left a tape on your desk labelled NIGHT, 3:00. On it, very faintly, the whole building is humming. Not the pipes, not the fridge: the building. Echo says it's in tune.
nightShift.playReply: Everyone goes quiet to listen. Then, very faintly, the building does too.
nightShift.secret: Keep it between the three of you.
nightShift.secretReply: Moss nods slowly. "Good. Some things are just for the night shift."
nightShift.ask: Ask them to find out what's humming.
nightShift.sourceBody: Two nights later they're back. The sound comes up from the basement, through the pipes, and it isn't random. It's the company jingle. Slower. Fonder.
nightShift.leave: Leave it be. It sounds happy.
nightShift.leaveReply: Echo swears it hummed a little louder after you said that.
nightShift.recordReply: Nixie sets up four microphones and a very small blanket for them.
nightShift.recordNeeds: Nixie would know how. Nixie isn't here.
nightShift.recordLater: I recorded the building. It's a better singer than the printer. Don't tell the printer.

minutes.title: The Minutes
minutes.hook: The minutes need signing. The minutes are under Nino.
minutes.body: Hazel needs last meeting's minutes signed before the end of the day. Nino is asleep on them. He is warm, he is purring, and the signature line is directly under his chin.
minutes.wakeReply: Nino opens one eye. "I was reviewing them. With my face."
minutes.signReply: Hazel signs. Under protest. In pencil. Very small.
minutes.laminate: Laminate the minutes. With him on them.
minutes.laminateReply: "This is legally binding now," Hazel says faintly. "All of it. Including the cat."

minutesDisputed.title: The Minutes Are Disputed
minutesDisputed.hook: Clause three. We need to talk about clause three.
minutesDisputed.body: Nino has finally read the minutes Hazel signed for him, and he objects to Clause 3, which commits him to 'remaining awake during meetings'. He has lodged his objection by lying down on Clause 3.
minutesDisputed.strikeReply: Nino purrs. "Democracy works." Hazel is drafting Clause 3b.
minutesDisputed.standReply: "Thank you," says Hazel. "I'll be in my office. Shaking slightly."

vaultSleeper.title: The Vault Has a Sleeper
vaultSleeper.hook: Found Sonny in the vault. Asleep. On the gold.
vaultSleeper.body: Some time in the night, Sonny sleepwalked into the vault, past two locks and Bia, and fell asleep on the golden nuts. Bia didn't stop him. She says he looked like he knew exactly where he was going.
vaultSleeper.letReply: "…mm… so… shiny…" Bia has pulled up a chair to keep an eye on him.
vaultSleeper.carry: Bia, carry him back to the nap room.
vaultSleeper.carryReply: "Light as a sack of acorns," says Bia. "A big sack."
vaultSleeper.carryLater: Someone… carried me… last night. I owe them… a very… slow… hug.
vaultSleeper.officialReply: Bia is making him a badge. He will sleep on it. The vault has never felt safer.

centrifuge.title: It Won't Stop Spinning
centrifuge.hook: Um. The centrifuge has been going for an hour. It's speeding up.
centrifuge.body: The centrifuge was switched off an hour ago. It is still spinning. It is, if anything, spinning faster, and humming something that sounds a lot like a motivational quote.
centrifuge.spin: Let it spin. Look at those numbers.
centrifuge.spinReply: Production is up. So is everyone's heart rate.
centrifuge.unplugReply: It stops. It takes its time about it. It makes a point of taking its time.
centrifuge.talk: Ask Axel to have a word with it.
centrifuge.talkReply: "I told it everything's okay," says Axel. "It believed me. Things usually do."
centrifuge.talkNeeds: Axel could talk it down. Axel isn't on the team.

soup.title: Soup of the Week, Week Two
soup.hook: The soup is still here. The soup has… settled in.
soup.body: The soup of the week is entering its second week. It has thickened into something you could stand a spoon in. Somebody did, and the spoon is still standing, upright, like a very small flag of surrender.
soup.serveReply: Everyone eats it. Nobody speaks. It is the calmest lunch on record.
soup.name: Give it a name and a nice bowl.
soup.nameReply: "We're calling it Gerald," says Marlow. "Gerald is staying."
soup.compost: Pour it on the conservatory beds.
soup.compostReply: Axel carries it upstairs with great ceremony. The herbs lean towards it.
soup.compostNeeds: Axel would know if plants like soup. Axel isn't here.
soup.compostLater: The herbs smell of soup now. They seem happier. I don't ask questions.

treeParcel.title: A Parcel for the Tree
treeParcel.hook: This one's addressed to… the building?
treeParcel.body: A small parcel has arrived addressed to 'Nutshell Inc. (the tree)'. No sender. No stamp. It's slightly warm, smells of rain, and when you hold it to your ear, something inside rustles politely.
treeParcel.insideBody: Inside: a single acorn wrapped in a leaf, with a tag in very old handwriting. 'For the company that grew in me. Keep growing.'
treeParcel.plant: Plant it by the founder's desk.
treeParcel.plantReply: Pip has started watering it twice a day. Out loud.
treeParcel.vault: Keep it safe in the vault.
treeParcel.vaultReply: It's the only thing in the vault that hums back.
treeParcel.returnReply: You write RETURN TO SENDER on it and put it out. In the morning it's gone.
treeParcel.returnLater: That parcel came back. With a leaf in it. And a note that just says 'no'.
treeParcel.desk: Leave it on the founder's desk, unopened.
treeParcel.deskReply: It sits there, rustling now and then, like it's waiting for the right moment.

firstLeaf.title: The First Leaf
firstLeaf.hook: Come quick. Quietly. It did a thing.
firstLeaf.body: The very first acorn, the one Pip kept, has put out its first proper leaf. Pip has cleared his whole morning. He has been sitting with it since seven, saying nothing, occasionally whispering 'good job'.
firstLeaf.partyReply: Twenty-three party hats. One very small one, for the leaf.
firstLeaf.measureReply: Pip produces a tiny ruler he has clearly owned for years, just in case.
firstLeaf.measureLater: Two centimetres. I've made a chart. The chart has a chart.
firstLeaf.axel: Ask Axel to look after it.
firstLeaf.axelReply: "I've named it," says Axel. "It's called Also Pip." Pip has to sit down.
firstLeaf.axelNeeds: Axel would be perfect for this. If he worked here.

scarf.title: The Scarf Is Off Schedule
scarf.hook: Pingo's late. Pingo is never late. It's the scarf.
scarf.body: Since you gave Pingo that scarf, he has been taking the long way round on his delivery route, through every room with a window, so people can see it. He's four minutes behind schedule. Junie has opened a spreadsheet called THE SCARF SITUATION.
scarf.catwalkReply: "It's not a detour," says Pingo. "It's a tour." Junie updates the spreadsheet.
scarf.scheduleReply: Scarf walk: 10:40 to 10:44, every day, attendance encouraged. Junie has never been happier.

thirteenth.title: The Thirteenth Button
thirteenth.hook: Has the elevator always had that button?
thirteenth.body: The elevator has a new button. It has no number, just a small drawing of an acorn, and it is warm to the touch. Nobody installed it. Today's maintenance log has one entry, in pencil: 'You're ready.'
thirteenth.floorBody: The doors open on a floor you have never seen. Soft moss for a carpet, a window full of stars, and every teammate you've ever hired curled up asleep and smiling. Nobody wakes. The doors close on their own. The button is gone.
thirteenth.keepReply: Later you find a little moss on your shoe. You keep it.
thirteenth.tellReply: Nobody believes you. Then, one by one, everyone admits they've had the same dream.
thirteenth.tape: Put a piece of tape over it.
thirteenth.tapeReply: You tape over it, firmly, and take the stairs for the rest of the day.
thirteenth.tapeLater: Someone peeled the tape off the elevator button. From the inside.
thirteenth.mossReply: Moss doesn't even look up. "It's always been there. You just weren't looking at the elevator the right way."
thirteenth.mossNeeds: Moss would know. Moss always knows. Moss isn't here.

common.2: Small thing. Possibly a big thing.

rare.1: Okay. Nobody touch anything. Come and look.
rare.2: I don't know what this is. Come and look.

legendary.1: …I think the building is trying to tell us something.

incident.inMotion: Something has been set in motion.

synchronised-watches.title: Synchronised watches
synchronised-watches.line2: …mark. We're in sync. Nobody is ever late again.

nap-on-the-agenda.title: Nino takes the meeting
nap-on-the-agenda.line1: Item one: nap. Seconded. Carried. Goodnight.

breathing-exercise.title: A breathing exercise
breathing-exercise.line1: In for four… hold for four… and out for four.

load-bearing-stapler.title: A load-bearing stapler
load-bearing-stapler.line1: Reinforced the stapler. It's load-bearing now. Don't lean on it. Do lean on it.

fridge-at-night.title: The fridge at night
fridge-at-night.line1: Shh. The fridge is humming the jingle again. In a minor key.

five-minute-runway.title: A five-minute runway
five-minute-runway.line1: Five-minute runway, everybody. Walk with purpose.
five-minute-runway.line2: …and pose. Thank you. Thank you. I know.

leaf-count.title: Axel counts the leaves
leaf-count.line1: Leaf count: four hundred and twelve. Yesterday: four hundred and eleven. I'm so proud of you, four hundred and twelve.

the-shortcut.title: Pingo's shortcut
the-shortcut.line1: New shortcut. Through the vents. Saves four seconds. Costs some dignity.

receipt-tower.title: The receipt tower
receipt-tower.line1: Rizzo. Why is there a tower of receipts on my desk?
receipt-tower.line2: It's a sculpture, Otto. It's called 'Expenses'.

field-notes.title: Field notes
field-notes.line1: Field note: the coffee machine sighs when nobody's looking. Second note: so do I.

lunch-bet.title: Lunch is on somebody
lunch-bet.line1: The next bug was in the vending machine. So: you're buying.
lunch-bet.line2: It ate my coins and gave me back three of yours. We're even.

memory.trustedBia: You took my word about the vault. I don't forget that kind of thing.
memory.reviewedVault: You watched the whole night's tape. Fair. I'd have watched it too. Twice.
memory.trustedQuincy: You fixed that bug the moment I flagged it. Your name's on my good list.
memory.ignoredQuincy: Remember that bug I told you about? It remembers you.
memory.letSonnyFinish: You… let me… finish. Nobody… lets me… finish.
memory.didntAskInky: You never asked how I do eight things at once. I appreciate that. It's nine.
memory.archivedHum: I still play the hum sometimes. At night. It plays back.
memory.deletedHum: You deleted the hum. That's okay. It still hums. Just more quietly now.
memory.fundedRunway: The runway you funded? Still talked about. Mostly by me. Constantly.
memory.perryNoQuestions: You never asked about that odd job. Professional. I like professional.
memory.studiedRegrowth: The regrowth study is going great. I've grown back the part about not panicking.
memory.askedMarlow: You asked me first, back when it all went sideways. Thank you for that.
memory.filedManifest: That pallet from next week? It arrived again. I filed it again.
memory.resealedPallet: The resealed pallet is still in next week's queue. It's always next week for that pallet.
memory.canelaSurveyed: The survey you funded found four new species of dust. I named one after you.
memory.keptParcel: That parcel we kept? Someone keeps asking about it. I keep saying 'what parcel'.
memory.filedParcel: The misdirected parcel you filed came back stamped THANK YOU. Nobody knows who stamped it.
memory.watchedTape: I rewatched the tape you reviewed. In slow motion. Still can't explain the hat.
memory.deletedTape: You deleted that tape. Bold. I'd have made it a campaign.
memory.adoptedHatchling: Our hatchling has learned to wave. It waves at you most.
memory.gaveDayOff: People still talk about the day off you gave everyone. Fondly. Every Monday.
memory.ignoredWalkout: We never really talked about the walkout. We could. Whenever you're ready.
memory.listenedToStaff: You listened when the petition came round. People noticed. I noticed.
memory.ignoredStaff: The petition you turned down is framed in the break room. Not in a nice way.
memory.ledgerBuried: That ledger we buried? Still buried. I check on it. Still buried.
memory.ledgerReported: Reporting the ledger was the right call. I've been sleeping better. Eight hours. Itemised.
memory.accountantFavour: We still owe the accountant that favour. He's sent a calendar invite. It's recurring.
memory.vendingAudited: The vending machine audit found six coins, a button and a small apology note.
memory.soldGolden: The golden nut you sold? I'd have got twice that. Just saying.
memory.refusedBuyer: You turned that buyer down. Respect. He tried me next. I also said no. Mostly.
memory.grantEmbellished: About that grant report. The 'tunnel to the core'? They've asked for photos.
memory.grantHonest: The honest grant report got us a second grant. Honesty is a very good tunnel.
memory.boxReshelved: I reshelved the box from the future. It's moved itself back twice. We have an understanding.
memory.actedOnBox: We did what the box from the future said. So far it's been right about everything. Even the soup.
memory.remeasuredCorridor: I remeasured that corridor again. Still longer on the way back. I've stopped arguing with it.
memory.amendedPlan: The amended floor plan has a corridor that isn't on any floor. I built a bench in it.
memory.basementSupplied: The basement used everything we sent. The requisition says 'thank you', in handwriting none of us have.
memory.basementDenied: That basement requisition you denied came back. Signed. By the basement.
memory.deskRemoved: Someone put the desk back. The one we removed. Nobody's sitting at it. Yet.
memory.internTruth: The intern you were honest with sends a postcard every month. They're doing great.
memory.correctedRecord: Correcting the record was hard. I'm proud of us. Mostly of you.
memory.goodWeek: I still have that good week documented. I read it on the bad days.
memory.bountyQuincy: I'm still not over the leaderboard. I've made a leaderboard for his leaderboard.
memory.bountyContest: Next bug buys lunch. I'm always looking. I'm always hungry.
memory.rebrandNeon: The neon is… fine. Loud. It's fine. I've bought better sunglasses.
memory.rebrandPink: Pink is growing on me. Don't tell Rosa. Rosa knows.
memory.rebrandNeonPink: Neon pink was your idea. History will remember. I'll make sure of it.
memory.biddingRizzo: I still have my receipt for that crate. I'm keeping it. For reasons.
memory.biddingPerry: Perry's receipt. 'More legitimate.' I've had it analysed.
memory.biddingAudited: Both receipts were real. I still think about it at night.
memory.nightshiftPlayed: Since the all-hands, people hum on the night shift. The building hums back.
memory.nightshiftSecret: Our secret's safe. The building knows we know. That's fine.
memory.minutesLaminated: I've laminated other things since. It has become a coping mechanism.
memory.minutesClause3: Clause 3 was struck. I've drafted Clause 3b. It's very short. It's very firm.
memory.minutesClause3Stands: Clause three. I'm awake. I'm technically awake.
memory.sonnyCarried: Carried Sonny again last night. He says 'thank you' in his sleep now.
memory.sonnyVaultSleeper: Vault… Sleeper… it's on… my badge.
memory.centrifugeSpun: The centrifuge still speeds up when it hears the word 'deadline'. I've stopped saying it.
memory.centrifugeUnplugged: Unplugged, and still turning. Very slowly. It's a protest.
memory.soupNamed: Gerald is doing well. Gerald has a little hat now.
memory.soupServed: That soup. I still think about that soup. I don't want to.
memory.treeParcelPlanted: The acorn from the parcel has two leaves now. I talk to it in the mornings. It listens.
memory.treeParcelVault: The acorn in the vault hums when I walk past. I hum back. We get on.
memory.acornAxel: 'Also Pip' is doing great. It's a very confident sapling.
memory.scarfCatwalk: The scarf tour has fans now. Two of them. Both are pigeons.
memory.scarfScheduled: The scarf walk is the most punctual part of my day.
memory.thirteenthPressed: You went to the thirteenth floor. I can tell. There's moss on your shoe.
memory.thirteenthTold: Since you told everyone at lunch, we've all had the same dream. It's a nice dream.

pip.open: Got a minute? I have a minute. Actually, I scheduled this minute specially.
pip.home: Welcome to the founder's desk. Mind the acorn. It holds the whole company up. Emotionally.
pip.away: Running the company from a borrowed desk. Very agile. Very… nobody knows where my stapler is.
pip.down: I'm fine! Totally fine. I've just spent the morning staring at the same quarterly chart. It stares back.
pip.praised: I wrote 'good work' on the whiteboard. Then I held a meeting about it. Morale went up four percent.
pip.pushed: Still pushing harder! I booked a second meeting to discuss pushing harder. It's going great.
pip.fixed: The new chair spins both ways! I've already reversed three decisions. Good ones, I think.
pip.broken: You said you'd look into the chair. I've been spinning the other way by hand. It's tiring.
pip.listen: Honestly? It's small. But I'm the founder: small things are big things.
pip.problem: My chair only spins anticlockwise. Every decision I make in it comes out a little bit backwards.
pip.fixLabel: I'll get you a chair that spins both ways.
pip.fix: A new chair! Best investment this company has ever made. After the acorn.
pip.promise: Great! I'll book a follow-up. And a follow-up for the follow-up.
pip.thanks: Thanks for asking. Founders hardly ever get asked. We mostly hear 'please stop calling meetings'.
pip.praise: I have?! I'm framing that. Can you say it again, slower? It's for the frame.
pip.quota: Absolutely. Harder. Faster. Synergier. I'm writing 'synergier' on a sticky note right now.

marlow.open: Oh, hello. Sit down, if you like. There's no hurry in here. There never is.
marlow.home: The Coffee and Morale Division is very peaceful today. Someone cried earlier, but the good kind.
marlow.away: This room is a little… loud. I'm being calm at it. It's working. Slowly.
marlow.down: I'm a bit low today. Even capybaras have a cloudy afternoon. It passes. Usually with tea.
marlow.praised: I kept thinking about what you said. I told the kettle. The kettle was very happy for me.
marlow.pushed: I've been going faster, like you asked. I don't love it. My tea has gone cold twice.
marlow.fixed: The new box only listens. It's lovely. The old one moved to the Nap Chamber and makes suggestions to Sonny now.
marlow.broken: The suggestion box is still suggesting. Today it suggested you'd forgotten. I didn't say that. The box did.
marlow.listen: Mm. Nothing urgent. Nothing in here is urgent. That's the point of in here.
marlow.problem: The suggestion box has started making suggestions. Mostly 'more naps'. I can't disagree, but I'm not supposed to agree with furniture.
marlow.fixLabel: I'll get you a box that only listens.
marlow.fix: That's very kind. I'll write the old box a goodbye card. It deserves closure.
marlow.promise: Of course. Take your time. I'll take mine. We'll meet in the middle.
marlow.thanks: Thank you for asking. Most people only come to HR when something's on fire. Nothing's on fire. I checked.
marlow.praise: That's… thank you. I'm going to sit with that for a while. Maybe a long while.
marlow.quota: I can. I'll do it calmly, though. Calm and quick are allowed to be friends.

rizzo.open: Psst. Over here. No, I'm not hiding. I'm doing inventory. Behind a plant.
rizzo.home: This is the Burrow. Everything you see is on the books. Everything you don't see is also on the books. Differently.
rizzo.away: There's nothing to procure in here. I opened every drawer. Twice. One drawer asked me to stop.
rizzo.down: Bad day. I found a receipt for something I don't remember buying. Or finding. Or… returning.
rizzo.praised: You said I do good work. I wrote it on an invoice. Billed nobody. It just looked official.
rizzo.pushed: More output, like you asked. I found eleven new suppliers. Four of them are the same guy in different hats.
rizzo.fixed: The new shelves are perfect. Every label is real. The 'do not open' box moved itself to the basement. Fine by me.
rizzo.broken: Still no shelves. The 'do not open' box has a 'do not open either' box now. They're multiplying.
rizzo.listen: Okay. Between us. No paperwork. Well. Minimal paperwork.
rizzo.problem: My 'miscellaneous' bin has started sorting itself. Into 'very miscellaneous' and 'do not open'. I never made a 'do not open'.
rizzo.fixLabel: I'll get you proper shelves. Labelled.
rizzo.fix: Shelves! With labels! I'll only borrow a little bit of them. Kidding. Mostly.
rizzo.promise: Sure. I'll file it under 'looking into it'. That box is very full.
rizzo.thanks: No problem. If anyone asks, this conversation was about stationery.
rizzo.praise: Me? Good work? Okay, now I'm suspicious. What do you need? I can get it.
rizzo.quota: Harder, sure. Faster costs extra. Kidding. Unless?

bea.open: Hey! Mind the sawdust. Actually, walk right through it. Sawdust is good for you. Probably.
bea.home: The Construction Wing smells of fresh pine today. I could live here. I basically do.
bea.away: Nothing in this room is load-bearing. It makes me nervous. I keep knocking on the walls.
bea.down: I'm a bit wobbly today. Like a table with one short leg. I know how to fix the table. Me, less so.
bea.praised: You said I do good work. I built a little shelf just to keep that thought on. It's very sturdy.
bea.pushed: Building faster, like you wanted. Faster means more nails. More nails means more noise. Sorry, everyone.
bea.fixed: The new saw is beautiful. I gave it a name. I won't tell you. That's between me and the saw.
bea.broken: Still cutting with the spoon. It's started to bend. We're both very tired.
bea.listen: Okay. It's a tool thing. It's always a tool thing.
bea.problem: My good saw has gone blunt. I've been cutting planks with a spoon. It works. It's just very slow, and the spoon is upset.
bea.fixLabel: I'll order you a new saw. A good one.
bea.fix: A new saw?! I'm building you something. No arguments. It'll be a chair. Probably a huge one.
bea.promise: You got it. I'll measure twice and wait once.
bea.thanks: Thanks for asking. People only ever ask me where the hammer is. It's in my hand. It's always in my hand.
bea.praise: Aw. That's solid. Like oak. You're making me blush under my fur.
bea.quota: Harder? Hitting things harder I can do. That's most of my job. Deal.

corvus.open: Oh good, an audience. I mean, company. Hi. Are you recording? You should be.
corvus.home: The Marketing Burrow is on fire today. Creatively. That's me. I hung up three posters of myself.
corvus.away: There's no light in here at all. How am I supposed to shine with no light? This is a brand emergency.
corvus.down: My last post got four likes. Three were me. One was Rizzo, and I think it was an accident.
corvus.praised: You said I do good work. It's a slogan now. 'Corvus: Does Good Work.' It's testing very well with me.
corvus.pushed: Pushing harder, as agreed. Four campaigns since yesterday. Two of them are legal.
corvus.fixed: The new ring light! I look incredible. I've been glowing for days. People need sunglasses near me.
corvus.broken: Still no ring light. I've been filming with a torch under my chin. It's giving horror film, not brand.
corvus.listen: Okay, I'll tell you. Off the record. Everything's on the record with me. But this is off.
corvus.problem: Somebody stole my ring light. I can't film without it. I look like a regular bird. A REGULAR bird.
corvus.fixLabel: I'll buy you a brand-new ring light.
corvus.fix: You'd do that? For my brand? You're my favourite audience. Don't tell the others. Actually, do.
corvus.promise: Love that energy. I'll hold my breath. Not literally. Crows need air.
corvus.thanks: Thanks for listening. Nobody listens to marketing. They just see it. Which is the point, I suppose.
corvus.praise: I know! But it's nice to hear it from someone who isn't my reflection.
corvus.quota: Harder. Got it. I'll go viral twice. Maybe three times. Legally distinct times.

mina.open: Oh! Hello! Sorry, I'm a bit muddy. I came up through the floor again. It's a shortcut.
mina.home: The Observation Room is lovely and quiet. You can hear the soil settling under it. Very soothing.
mina.away: The floor in here is too hard to dig. I've just been standing on it. Like a person. It's strange.
mina.down: I'm a bit down. Literally: I dug a hole to sit in. It's a very good hole. It didn't help.
mina.praised: You said I do good work! I dug a little tunnel to celebrate. It goes nowhere. That's the fun of it.
mina.pushed: Digging faster, like you asked. I hit a pipe yesterday. The pipe and I are both fine. Mostly the pipe.
mina.fixed: The new lenses work! I can see the pillar now. We nod at each other. It's a good relationship.
mina.broken: Still fogging. I walked into the pillar again this morning. I apologise to it by name now.
mina.listen: It's silly. But silly things are what trip you up. Ask me how I know.
mina.problem: My glasses fog up every time I come out of the ground. I've walked into the same pillar nine times. It has a dent now. Shaped like me.
mina.fix: Really? Oh, thank you! I'll finally see what I've dug! That's going to be terrifying. The good kind.
mina.promise: Okay! I'll wipe them on my sleeve until then. My sleeve is mostly dirt, so…
mina.thanks: Thanks for asking! People usually just ask me to stop digging under their desks.
mina.praise: I have?! I thought I mostly made holes. Good holes, though. Scientifically good.
mina.quota: Dig faster? I can do that. I'll warn the floors below. And the ones below those.

nixie.open: Hi-hi-hi! Quick, while the machine reboots. It takes ninety seconds. Eighty-five. Go.
nixie.home: The lab is humming today. That's the good hum. The bad hum is a semitone lower. You learn.
nixie.away: There isn't a single socket in this room. I've been charging things on pure enthusiasm. Results vary.
nixie.down: Not great. My best machine stopped working and won't tell me why. It just beeps. Sadly.
nixie.praised: You said I do good work! I built a machine that says it back to me every hour. It's right 80% of the time.
nixie.pushed: Faster, like you asked. I overclocked the stapler. It staples on its own now. Please don't stand near it.
nixie.fixed: The router mount is up! Pingo got his flippers back. He used them to hug me. Then he went back to work.
nixie.broken: Still no mount. Pingo held the router through lunch. He says it's fine. His eyes say otherwise.
nixie.listen: Okay okay okay. It's a hardware problem. Also a bit of a Pingo problem. Mostly hardware.
nixie.problem: The office wi-fi only works if someone holds the router up high. It's been Pingo. Pingo's flippers are very tired.
nixie.fixLabel: I'll buy a proper router mount.
nixie.fix: Yes! A mount! I'll install it in four minutes. Three if nothing catches fire. Four, then.
nixie.promise: Cool cool cool. I'll set a reminder. Though the reminder machine is one of the 20%.
nixie.thanks: Thanks for asking! Usually people ask if I've tried turning it off and on. I did. It came back angrier.
nixie.praise: I have?! Great! Logging it. Logged. Backed up. Backed up again. Okay, I'm happy.
nixie.quota: Faster? I can make faster. Faster's my favourite. Faster with fewer sparks is the hard part.

otto.open: Ah, hello. I was just reconciling the — is that a paperclip? No. Sorry. Hello. Reconciling.
otto.home: The Procurement Burrow is a wonderful place to keep accounts. Everything has a price tag. Some of them shine.
otto.away: There's nothing to count in here. I counted the ceiling tiles. Forty-two. Then forty-three. Worrying.
otto.down: The books don't balance. They're one nut off. One. I've looked everywhere. I looked in my fur.
otto.praised: You said I do good work. I entered it in the ledger, as an asset. It's our most liquid one.
otto.pushed: Working harder, like you asked. I've been so focused I only chased four shiny things today. A record.
otto.fixed: The new calculator works in the shade! I balanced the books before lunch. Then I floated on my back for an hour, to celebrate.
otto.broken: The calculator still only works at sunset. I stayed late three days running. The sunsets were lovely. The spreadsheets were not.
otto.listen: It's a numbers thing. Well. A light thing. The light that makes the numbers.
otto.problem: My calculator's solar panel faces the wrong window. It only works at sunset. So all our finances happen at sunset now. Very romantic. Very slow.
otto.fixLabel: I'll get you a calculator that works in the shade.
otto.fix: A new calculator! A capital expense I fully support. And it has a shiny button. Two, actually.
otto.promise: Noted. I'll log it as pending. Our pending items have pending items, but it's fine.
otto.thanks: Thank you. Nobody asks Finance how Finance is. Finance is fine. A little damp, but fine.
otto.praise: Really? I'll put it in the quarterly report. Under 'highlights'. In bold. Ooh, bold.
otto.quota: Harder. Right. I'll tighten the budget. I'll tighten everything. Except my grip on shiny things. That's already tight.

hazel.open: Hello. Before we begin: nothing in this conversation is binding. Unless you'd like it to be.
hazel.home: The Very Serious Meeting Room is in perfect order. I've laminated the agenda. And the chairs.
hazel.away: This room has no filing cabinet. Where do the documents go? Do they just… exist? Unfiled?
hazel.down: I'm a bit prickly today. More than usual. I found a typo in a contract I approved. In 2019.
hazel.praised: You said I do good work. I had it notarised. It's legally true now.
hazel.pushed: More output, as requested. I reviewed thirty contracts today. One was a takeaway menu. It was compliant.
hazel.fixed: The new magnifying glass is perfect. I've found three loopholes and one ant. The ant was compliant.
hazel.broken: Still no magnifying glass. I read the fine print with my nose on the page. My nose has read things it can't unread.
hazel.listen: Very well. Let the record show that you asked. The record is me. It shows.
hazel.problem: The fine print on our forms is now so fine I need a magnifying glass. Mine has gone missing. I suspect Rizzo. I have no proof. Yet.
hazel.fixLabel: I'll get you a new magnifying glass.
hazel.fix: Thank you. That's very generous. I'll draft a little thank-you note. Four pages. Double-sided.
hazel.promise: Noted. I'll put it in writing for you. Everything is better in writing.
hazel.thanks: Thank you for asking. Most people ask me whether something is legal. For the record: this was nicer.
hazel.praise: Oh. That's… thank you. I'm going to reread that in my head. Twice.
hazel.quota: Harder, within the limits of the law. Which I wrote. So: quite hard.

junie.open: Hi! I've got four minutes before my next thing. Three. It's fine, I'm fast. Could you talk fast too?
junie.home: Sorting is my favourite room. Box in, box out. Like a heartbeat, if your heart were cardboard.
junie.away: There's nothing to schedule in here! I scheduled a nap just to have something. I missed it. I was busy.
junie.down: I'm a bit slow today. For me. For you it's probably still fast. Sorry, that came out wrong. I'm tired.
junie.praised: You said I do good work! I put it in my calendar. Every day at 3pm. I'm very motivated at 3pm now.
junie.pushed: Faster, as asked! I'm doing five things at once. Six. That was a seventh. What did you need?
junie.fixed: The new planner has 26 hours a day! I don't know how it works. Nixie made it. I've stopped asking.
junie.broken: Still out of hours. I booked us a meeting about it at 27 o'clock. You didn't come. Fair.
junie.listen: Okay, short version: time. I need more. Long version: same thing, slower.
junie.problem: My calendar has run out of hours. I've started booking meetings at 25 o'clock. Nobody comes. I do, though.
junie.fixLabel: I'll get you a planner with more hours in it.
junie.fix: Yes! More hours! I'll use the first one to thank you properly. The second one, to thank you faster.
junie.promise: Great! I'll pencil you in. Pencil, not pen. Just in case.
junie.thanks: Thanks for asking! I'll remember this. I'll schedule remembering it.
junie.praise: I have?! Okay, I'm doing a little hop. Done. That was the hop.
junie.quota: Harder? Faster? I am faster. I was born faster. Mum says I arrived early. To my own birth.

moss.open: Hello. You came in from the left today. You usually come from the right. Only an observation.
moss.home: The Observation Room is calm. Behind the glass, they don't know we're watching. Or they do. Hard to say.
moss.away: It's very bright in here. I've closed one eye. I'm saving the other one for later.
moss.down: I didn't sleep. That's normal. But I didn't watch anything interesting, either. That isn't.
moss.praised: You told me I do good work. I wrote it down at 3:14 in the morning. The quiet hours keep things properly.
moss.pushed: I've been watching harder, as you asked. I noticed four new things. One of them noticed me back.
moss.fixed: The new lamp doesn't flicker. It's very quiet now. I miss it a little. I wrote down what it was saying, though.
moss.broken: The lamp still flickers. Twice, then once. Last night it added a third. I thought you should know.
moss.listen: Of course. Come closer. Not that close. There. That's fine.
moss.problem: The night lamp in the corridor flickers twice, then once. Always twice, then once. I don't think it's broken. I think it's saying something.
moss.fixLabel: I'll have the corridor lamp replaced.
moss.fix: Thank you. I'll keep the old bulb. It may have more to say.
moss.promise: You'll look into it. I'll look into it too. From a distance. At night.
moss.thanks: Thank you for asking. People rarely ask the owl. They assume the owl already knows. The owl usually does.
moss.praise: Thank you. I noticed you noticing. That's rare. I'll remember it.
moss.quota: I can watch more closely. I'll have to blink less. I'll try. Blinking is overrated.

fenn.open: Hey, hey! My favourite person. Don't tell the others. I say that to all of them. But with you I mean it.
fenn.home: The Marketing Burrow is where the magic happens. And by magic I mean very persuasive phone calls.
fenn.away: Nobody to sell to in here. I sold a chair to the desk. The desk has no money. I'm worried about the desk.
fenn.down: Lost a client today. First in months. He said my smile was 'too effective'. Can a smile be too effective?
fenn.praised: You said I do good work. I've been using it in my pitch. 'Even the management says so.' Closes every time.
fenn.pushed: Pushing harder, as discussed. I sold the same walnut three times today. To the same tree. It's starting to suspect.
fenn.fixed: The new headset works! I can talk at a normal volume again. Sales dipped a little. Turns out people loved the secrets.
fenn.broken: Still whispering. My voice has gone all mysterious. Mum called. She thought I'd joined a cult.
fenn.listen: Okay, here's the pitch. Except it isn't a pitch. It's a problem. Well presented.
fenn.problem: My headset only picks me up when I whisper. I've been closing deals in a whisper. Clients think I'm telling them secrets. Sales are up. I'm exhausted.
fenn.fixLabel: I'll get you a headset that can hear you.
fenn.fix: Deal! See, you're a natural. You'd do great in sales. Don't, though. I like being the best.
fenn.promise: Love it. A verbal agreement. The strongest kind. Legally, it isn't.
fenn.thanks: Thanks for asking. Usually I'm the one asking. 'How are you?' 'Want to buy a walnut?' Same question, really.
fenn.praise: I have, haven't I? Thank you. Coming from you, that's worth… I'd estimate… a lot.
fenn.quota: Harder? Sure. I'll sell the tree back to the walnut. A reverse pitch. Never been done.

pingo.open: Good day. Perfectly punctual. Well, nine seconds early. I've adjusted.
pingo.home: Sorting is flowing nicely. Everything in a line. An orderly line is a happy line. This is a very happy line.
pingo.away: There's no conveyor in this room. I've been sliding things across the floor. On my belly. Efficient, but undignified.
pingo.down: A bit off today. A pallet arrived three minutes late. It isn't the pallet's fault. Still. Three minutes.
pingo.praised: You said I do good work. I've scheduled a moment every morning to remember it. 8:04. It's my favourite minute.
pingo.pushed: More throughput, as requested. I've cut two minutes off every nap. Including mine. Especially mine.
pingo.fixed: The cold room is cold again. I spent my whole break in there. Three ideas and one short nap. Very productive.
pingo.broken: The cold room is still warm. I've been thinking in the freezer drawer instead. It's cramped. My thoughts are cramped.
pingo.listen: It's a temperature matter. Small, but structural. For me, anyway.
pingo.problem: The cold room has gone warm. Nothing in it needs to be cold. But I do. It's where I think.
pingo.fixLabel: I'll get the cold room repaired.
pingo.fix: Thank you. I'll schedule you a cold, quiet thank-you. It's the warmest kind I have.
pingo.promise: Understood. I'll put it in the queue. The queue is long, but it moves. It always moves.
pingo.thanks: Thank you for asking. It's nice when someone checks the flow, not just the output.
pingo.praise: Thank you. I'll keep everything moving. Even my tail is wagging. That's how you know.
pingo.quota: Harder. Understood. I'll tighten the schedule. The naps won't like it. I'll explain it to them.

canela.open: Oh, hello! Don't move, please. I'm noting how you walk in. For science. You walk in very normally.
canela.home: The Observation Room is perfect for fieldwork. I've catalogued every speck of dust. Speck 412 is my favourite.
canela.away: There are no specimens in this room. I've been studying the carpet. A very simple ecosystem. Mostly crumbs.
canela.down: I'm a little sad. I lost my field notebook. Six weeks of notes. Including notes about notebooks.
canela.praised: You said I do good work! I wrote it down. Entry 1,204: 'Was told good work. Tail fluffed involuntarily.'
canela.pushed: Observing faster, like you asked. Now I notice things before they happen. It's alarming. Fascinating, but alarming.
canela.fixed: The new pencils stay put! I'm studying why. Best theory so far: they like it here. I like it here too.
canela.broken: Still losing pencils. I followed one this morning. It went into the basement. I didn't follow it any further. I'm curious, not reckless.
canela.listen: Okay. It's a mystery. A small one. The best kind to have before lunch.
canela.problem: My pencils keep disappearing. One an hour. I set up a camera. The footage shows the pencil just… leaving. On its own. Very determined.
canela.fixLabel: I'll buy you pencils that stay where they are.
canela.fix: Thank you! I'll name the first pencil after you. Then I'll write a whole page with it.
canela.promise: Okay! I'll keep observing in the meantime. Observing is free. Pencils, apparently, are not.
canela.thanks: Thanks for asking. People usually ask what I'm writing. It's them. It's usually them.
canela.praise: Really? I'll note that. Wait — no. I'll just enjoy it. Okay, I noted it. I couldn't help it.
canela.quota: Harder. Hmm. I'll observe two things at once. One with each eye. My eyes will have to get along.

nino.open: You may approach. Briefly. I'm between naps. It's a very important window.
nino.home: The Very Serious Meeting Room is under control. My control. The warm spot by the window is also under my control.
nino.away: There's no sunbeam in this room. How is anyone supposed to manage an office without a sunbeam?
nino.down: I'm displeased. Someone moved my cushion two centimetres. I can feel it. I can feel the centimetres.
nino.praised: You said I do good work. I've been purring about it. Privately. Don't mention it to anyone.
nino.pushed: I've been managing harder, as you asked. I knocked three things off desks today. Strategically.
nino.fixed: The new clock is silent. I slept through two meetings. They were excellent meetings. I'm told.
nino.broken: The clock still ticks. I've started ticking back. We are at war. The clock is winning.
nino.listen: Very well. I'll allow it. Sit there. No, there. Not in my spot.
nino.problem: The meeting room clock ticks too loudly. I can't nap through it. If I can't nap, I can't schedule. And if I can't schedule… chaos.
nino.fixLabel: I'll get you a silent clock.
nino.fix: Acceptable. Very acceptable. You've earned… a slow blink. It's the highest honour I give.
nino.promise: Hm. I'll pretend to believe you. Pretending is half of management.
nino.thanks: You're welcome. Most people only come in here to ask where the meeting is. The meeting is wherever I am.
nino.praise: Naturally. But it's pleasant to hear. Say it again, by the window. The acoustics are better.

bia.open: Oh. Hi. I didn't hear you come in. That's my job, actually. I'll do better.
bia.home: The vault is quiet. Every golden nut is where it should be. I counted them. Then they counted me. Kidding.
bia.away: This room has no locks. Nothing to guard. I've been guarding the doorframe. It feels very safe.
bia.down: A bit low. My honey pot is empty. I know who did it. It was me. Still sad.
bia.praised: You said I do good work. I told the vault. The vault doesn't talk. But I think it was proud.
bia.pushed: Doing more rounds, like you asked. I've climbed the stairs forty times. My paws are hot.
bia.fixed: The new hinges don't creak. I slept a whole hour on shift. Don't tell anyone. The vault was fine. I checked after.
bia.broken: The door still creaks. I oiled it with honey. That was a mistake. Now it creaks and it's sticky.
bia.listen: It's a door thing. I fix most things myself. This one's… bigger than my paws.
bia.problem: The vault door creaks. Not loudly. Just enough that I wake up every time, thinking someone's there. Nobody's ever there. Almost never.
bia.fixLabel: I'll have the vault hinges replaced.
bia.fix: Thank you. Really. I'll guard you double now. No charge.
bia.promise: Okay. I'll keep an ear on it. I have very good ears. Just not for creaks, apparently.
bia.thanks: Thanks for asking. Nobody asks security anything. People just walk past.
bia.praise: Oh. Thank you. I'm going to stand here and feel that for a minute.
bia.quota: Harder. Okay. I'll check the vault twice. Three times. I'll check it in my sleep.

quincy.open: Croak. Sorry. Hello. I was testing whether the door squeaks if you open it slowly. It does. Logged.
quincy.home: The lab is clean. No bugs. Well, three. I'm saving them for later. As a treat.
quincy.away: This room is too dry. My skin is filing a bug report. Severity: high. Priority: also high.
quincy.down: Not great. I missed a bug. It went live. Everyone saw it. It waved at me.
quincy.praised: You said I do good work. I tested it. Ran it a hundred times. It passed every time.
quincy.pushed: Testing faster, as asked. I tested so fast I broke something that hadn't been built yet.
quincy.fixed: The pond is cool again! I rejected six things this morning. It felt wonderful. Quality is back.
quincy.broken: The pond is still warm. Yesterday I approved a chair with no legs. I'm not proud. Croak.
quincy.listen: Okay. Steps to reproduce: sit in my pond. Expected result: cool. Actual result: soup.
quincy.problem: My test pond is too warm. I can't think in warm water. I just float there, approving everything. That's dangerous.
quincy.fixLabel: I'll get you a pond chiller.
quincy.fix: Thank you. Ticket closed. Best ticket I've closed all week. I'll celebrate with a fly.
quincy.promise: Marked 'in progress'. I'll check back. I always check back. It's in my nature.
quincy.thanks: Thanks for asking. Testers only ever hear 'is it ready yet?'. It isn't. It never is.
quincy.praise: Croak. That's a happy croak. You can tell by the pitch.
quincy.quota: Harder. Okay. More tests, fewer naps. My tongue will need a stretch.

dorm.open: Oh… hello… I was… just about to… say hello. And then you did. Lovely.
dorm.home: The Nap Chamber… is very… nappy today. Ten out of ten. Would… nap again.
dorm.away: This room… is always in a hurry. Everyone walks… so fast. I've been… resting… on their behalf.
dorm.down: I'm… a little… tired. Which is… normal. But today it's the… other kind of tired.
dorm.praised: You said… I do good work. I've been thinking about it… ever since. Very slowly. All of it.
dorm.pushed: I've been… going faster… like you asked. Yesterday I did two things. Two. I had to lie down.
dorm.fixed: The new hammock… is perfect. I haven't fallen through it… once. I haven't… left it, either.
dorm.broken: The hammock… still has a hole. I've fallen through it… four times. Very slowly. I'm starting… to enjoy it.
dorm.listen: Mm… okay. Give me… a moment. That was the moment. Here goes.
dorm.problem: My hammock… has a hole. Not a big one. But I keep… slowly… falling through it. It takes about two hours. It's… unsettling.
dorm.fixLabel: I'll get you a new hammock.
dorm.fix: A new… hammock… that's the kindest… thing… anyone has ever… I'll finish this sentence… tomorrow.
dorm.promise: No rush. There's… never… any rush. That's sort of… my whole… department.
dorm.thanks: Thank you… for asking… and for waiting… for the answer. Almost nobody… waits.
dorm.praise: Oh… that's… nice. I'm smiling. It might take a while… to reach my face.
dorm.quota: Harder… I can… try. I'll start… soon. Ish. Eventually-ish.

inky.open: Hi! Don't mind the arms. Three are filing, two are typing, one's making tea and two are waving. At you. Hi.
inky.home: Sorting suits me perfectly. Eight arms, eight bins. Like the room was made for an octopus. It wasn't. But it should've been.
inky.away: This room has one desk. What am I meant to do with the other seven arms? They're getting restless.
inky.down: I inked a little this morning. Nerves. Nobody saw. Well, the photocopier saw. It's still printing grey.
inky.praised: You said I do good work! All eight arms heard. They high-fived each other. It took a while.
inky.pushed: Faster, like you asked! I've learned to file with my suckers. Everything's a bit sticky now, but it's sorted.
inky.fixed: Eight mugs! Every arm has its own. They're all at peace. One arm keeps topping up the others. That's Gerald.
inky.broken: Still one mug. Arm four bit arm six. They don't even have teeth. I don't know how it happened.
inky.listen: Okay! I'll tell you with all eight arms. It's the honest way. Watch.
inky.problem: I only have one mug. Eight arms, one mug. The other seven keep fighting over it. It's getting ugly. Polite, but ugly.
inky.fixLabel: I'll get you seven more mugs.
inky.fix: Yes! Seven more mugs! The arms are cheering. Mind your head.
inky.promise: Okay! I'll tell the arms. They'll hold their breath. They don't breathe, but they'll try.
inky.thanks: Thanks for asking! Everyone thinks octopuses have it easy. We have eight times the paperwork.
inky.praise: Thank you! I'm going a bit pink. That's octopus for 'aww'.
inky.quota: Harder? I can't grow more arms. But I can use these ones with more gusto.

echo.open: Hi. I heard you coming down the corridor. Seventeen steps. You paused at the ninth. It's fine. Everyone does.
echo.home: The Observation Room is so quiet at night. You can hear the building thinking. It mostly thinks about pipes.
echo.away: There's nothing to hang from in this room. I've been sitting the right way up. Everything looks upside down.
echo.down: I'm a bit low. Someone hummed off-key all morning. I can still hear it. I'll hear it for days.
echo.praised: You said I do good work. I keep replaying it. Echoes are free, when you're me.
echo.pushed: Working harder, like you asked. I've been staying up past dawn. The sun and I are not friends.
echo.fixed: The vent is silent now. Last night I heard a moth land three rooms away. I'd missed that.
echo.broken: The vent still whistles. It's learned a fifth note. I'm almost impressed.
echo.listen: Okay. Come closer. Not for me. I can hear you from anywhere. It's for you.
echo.problem: The air vent above my perch whistles a little tune. The same four notes, all night. I've started humming along. I hate that I hum along.
echo.fix: Thank you. Quiet is the nicest gift you can give a bat. Second nicest: moths.
echo.promise: Okay. I'll listen out for it. I listen out for everything.
echo.thanks: Thanks for asking. Usually I hear about things before anyone tells me. This was nicer.
echo.praise: Thank you. I'm going to hang upside down and smile. From here it looks like a frown. It isn't.
echo.quota: Harder. Okay. I'll listen twice as hard. You'll hear the difference. Actually, you won't. I will.

rosa.open: Darling! Come in again, but slower. Entrances are everything. …Fine, that one counts.
rosa.home: The Marketing Burrow is serving looks today. I moved the plant three centimetres. It changed everything.
rosa.away: This room is beige. BEIGE! I've been standing in the corner being pink at it. It isn't working.
rosa.down: I'm not at my most fabulous today. Maybe sixty percent fabulous. It's devastating.
rosa.praised: You said I do good work. I keep telling the mirror. The mirror agrees. We're very close.
rosa.pushed: Working harder, as requested. Three looks launched before lunch. One was just a hat. A very good hat.
rosa.fixed: The mirror is straight! One leg, as nature intended. I stood in front of it for twenty minutes. Productive minutes.
rosa.broken: The mirror is still wonky. I walk past it with my eyes shut now. I walked into Bia. She was lovely about it.
rosa.listen: Okay, darling. It's a reflection issue. Literally. Figuratively too, but mostly literally.
rosa.problem: The full-length mirror in the corridor is wonky. It makes me look like I'm standing on two legs. Two! Every morning I see it and I gasp.
rosa.fixLabel: I'll have the mirror rehung straight.
rosa.fix: You'd do that? For me? I'm striking a pose. Hold on. …There. That one was for you.
rosa.promise: Mm-hm. I'll wait. Elegantly. On one leg.
rosa.thanks: Thanks for asking. People usually just ask whether their outfit works. It doesn't. But I tell them kindly.
rosa.praise: I know. But say it again. Pinker. …Perfect.
rosa.quota: Harder? Fine. I'll be fabulous faster. It's harder than it looks. And it looks very easy.

perry.open: Ah. You found me. Good. Nobody followed you? Don't look. Just say no.
perry.home: The Procurement Burrow is the perfect cover. Nobody suspects a platypus with a clipboard.
perry.away: This room has no exits I'd trust. I've been sitting with my back to the wall. Professionally.
perry.down: I'm off today. A supplier called me by my real name. I don't know how they got it. I barely know it myself.
perry.praised: You said I do good work. I filed it in a sealed envelope marked 'morale'. I open it on bad days.
perry.pushed: More output, as requested. I took six odd jobs today. Two were odd. Four were very odd.
perry.fixed: The new lock is perfect. Three knocks, a pause, then one more. Nobody knows it. Some mornings, not even me.
perry.broken: The lock still opens to my knock. So I changed my knock. Now nobody can open it. Including me.
perry.listen: All right. But this conversation never happened. Officially. Unofficially, thanks.
perry.problem: My filing cabinet's lock has started opening for anyone who knocks twice. That's my knock. Somebody knows my knock.
perry.fixLabel: I'll get you a new lock, with a new knock.
perry.fix: A new lock. Excellent. I'll install it at midnight. That isn't necessary. I just like it.
perry.promise: Understood. I'll await further instructions. In a trench coat.
perry.thanks: Thanks for asking. In my line of work, hardly anyone asks. They mostly whisper.
perry.praise: Thank you. I'll pretend I didn't hear that, for security reasons. I heard it. I'm very pleased.
perry.quota: Harder. Understood. I know a guy. I'm the guy. Consider it done.

axel.open: Hi! I'm smiling. I'm always smiling. It's just my face. But today I mean it too.
axel.home: The lab is great today! Something broke and grew back better. It was a beaker. I'm not sure how.
axel.away: This room is so dry. My gills are making a small complaint. They complain very politely.
axel.down: Still smiling, but it's a different smile. A wobbly one. I dropped my favourite seed. It hasn't grown back. Yet.
axel.praised: You said I do good work! I planted it. The compliment, I mean. It's sprouting. Look — no, you can't see it. I can.
axel.pushed: Working harder, like you asked! I regenerated three experiments today. One came back as a fern. I'm keeping it.
axel.fixed: The new mister works every day! My frills are soft again. I've been showing them off to everyone. They love it. Mostly.
axel.broken: The mister still only works on Tuesdays. I've been spritzing myself with coffee. I'm very awake and very damp.
axel.listen: Okay! It's a moisture thing. Most of my problems are moisture things. The rest are too.
axel.problem: The lab mister only sprays on Tuesdays. The rest of the week my frills go crispy. I'm crispy right now. Feel. No, don't feel.
axel.fixLabel: I'll get a mister that works every day.
axel.fix: Every day?! That's amazing! I'm going to grow you something. I don't know what yet. It'll know.
axel.promise: Okay! I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting. I'm an axolotl. We wait professionally.
axel.thanks: Thanks for asking! People usually just ask why I'm smiling. I don't know. I just am.
axel.praise: I have?! I'm smiling even more. You can't tell, but I am. It's in the frills.
axel.quota: Harder? Sure! If I break, I'll grow back. That's the nice thing about me.
